description: Customization: a row x column facet with non-default header, spacing, sort and legend properties.

eas.threshold_reason: 2026-10-06 eas-agt.2: 120 stacked bars 7.2px thick in 8px steps. The theme's bar cornerRadiusEnd makes Vega-Lite draw each stack as a clipped group, and resvg (bin/chart) antialiases clip and bar both, so every bar edge drops to a quarter coverage: the reference shows 6.5px bars. Native geometry matches the Vega scene (drawn 0.4-0.8px thinner it differs only 0.006) and rsvg-convert does not compound a clip's antialiasing, so native differs 0.058-0.062; facet_grid_bar has the same 0.07 for the same reason.
